messages:
maya: T-minus ~2h until RC cutover. Quick heads-up — there's a late-merge exception request for a small semver bump (lib-compat) that touches runtime routing. @sam please paste the PR and test notes.

sam: PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/6245
small bump + compat shim. Change: adjust route fallback ordering so old clients don't 500. Tests: local unit + staging smoke (see logs). Asking for late merge exception — won't affect feature flags.

maya: Can you summarize the risk surface in 1-2 lines? We need a mitigation plan if this regresses during cutover.

sam: Risk: mis-ordered fallbacks could route a handful of requests to legacy model variant; impact = increased tail latency + rare 502.
Mitigation: 1) can ship behind a runtime feature flag (FF_RUNTIME_FALLBACK=v2) 2) can pin problematic customers to old commit during rollout 3) automatic rollback script ready.

raj: Not ideal this late. Does staging smoke show any end-to-end 502s?

sam: Staging smoke output (short):
```
OK: 998/1000 requests returned 200
WARN: 2/1000 returned 504 (timed out to legacy variant)
```
Root cause looks like a timing window on concurrent route updates; patch adds an ordering guard.

leo: If we can gate behind FF and do a gradual ramp (10% -> 50% -> 100%) with rollout checks, I'm 👍. Need the FF and rollout plan in the PR description.

maya: Action items for exception to be considered:
- sam: add FF flag + example env var to PR
- sam: add explicit canary rollout snippet to PR and Console guide
- raj: sign off on staging smoke after FF applied
- release-bot: hold open window for 30m exception approval from release captain

sam: Added FF and canary steps. Canary snippet: `curl -X POST $CONSOLE_API/rollouts -d '{"percent":10, "filter":"region=us-west"}'`
PR description updated with testing notes.

raj: Re-ran staging smoke with FF enabled, result: 1000/1000 200s, no 504s. Logs show fallback ordering consistent. :eyes:

maya: Great. @leo any concerns about changelog/backfill? We need a short entry in the RC notes explaining the compatibility shim.

leo: I'll add a 1-line changelog: "runtime: prioritize new fallback ordering to avoid 502s for legacy clients (semver patch)" and backfill user-impact note.

deploy-bot: Deploy window is locked for RC cutover. Exception requests flagged: ID=exc-2026. Additional approvals required: release-captain.

maya: Nominate for soft exception: this is low-risk with FF and canary, and successful staging smoke. @release-bot please escalate to release captain.

release-bot: Exception escalated to release-captain. Please note: exception window closes in 25m.

sam: One more note — added cherry-pick commands in PR for quick revert if needed:
```bash
# cherry-pick revert
git checkout release/rc-1.12
git revert -m 1 <merge-commit>
git push origin release/rc-1.12
```

raj: With FF + canary + revert steps, I approve.

leo: Approve. :thumbsup:

maya: Approved from release engineering side pending captain sign-off. If no objections here, I'll mark exception as granted and merge once captain signs.

release-bot: Release-captain approved exception ID=exc-2026 at 2865432348. Exception granted with condition: enable canary 10% for first 15 minutes, monitor token-error-rate and tail-latency dashboards.

maya: Exception granted. Sam, merge on green and kick the canary. Everyone — monitor dashboards for first 30m and be ready to rollback.

sam: Merging now. Will post canary start and metrics link.

leo: Adding RC notes and changelog entry.

maya: Thanks team. Closing thread after watch window. :white_check_mark:
